title: Shortest path on a grid
prompt:
Write a ModuleScript that returns a table with a function
`findPath(grid: {{boolean}}, start: Vector2, goal: Vector2): {Vector2}?`. `grid[y][x]` is true when the cell is
walkable (x and y start at 1). Moves go up, down, left or right one cell. Return the shortest path as a list of
Vector2 cells from start to goal (both included), or nil when the goal cannot be reached.
